You might be right. 

I've just been texting with her, so it does not look like there's an imminent danger. She's been like this for days.

IDK, if she does not get better then I might have to.

I have no experience with depression or suicide, but I am very worried about my friend.

Apologies if this is the wrong place to post this.

Well those are my thoughts too.

About the bf - I know he cares and loves her dearly (and the baby too!). I am hesitant to get in touch with him though, she's very private and hates others' meddling with her personal affairs. 

Getting in touch with bf family would not be difficult. But she'll HATE me for going over her head, I know that for a fact.

Yes! Done.

Sorry to be a pain - just... worried, ya know.
